postconditions.description: The number of magnets n is between 3 and 2000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(magnet in ['N', 'S', '-'] for magnet in magnets)
postconditions.description: Each magnet in the list of magnets is one of 'N', 'S', or '-'.

postconditions.expression: len([magnet for magnet in magnets if magnet == '-']) >= 1
postconditions.description: There is at least one demagnetized magnet ('-') among the magnets.

postconditions.expression: len([magnet for magnet in magnets if magnet != '-']) >= 2
postconditions.description: There are at least two magnets that are not demagnetized ('N' or 'S').
